ttea.util

Utility classes for the T-TEA platform.

Includes path management, CSV handling, dialogs, exception hooks, date formats, images, OpenCV text and the help system support.

Attributes

__version__str

Current package version.

__date__str

Release date of the package version.

__author__str

Package author or team.

__license__str

Package license.

See Also

CriticalHooks

Global exception hooks with a translated error dialog.

CSVHandler

Handling CSV files with a custom dialect.

CvText

Unicode text and window titles for OpenCV windows.

HelpKeyFilter

Application-wide F1 key handling for the help.

Image

Loading images from Qt resources as pygame surfaces.

MessageService

Centralized Qt message dialogs.

PathConfig

Manage file paths and directory structures.

QtDateFormat

Conversion of Python date formats to Qt formats.

Notes

This package is maintained by the Larva UDESC team and is under active development.

Contributions and bug reports are welcome at: https://github.com/larvattea/ttea
